entries.heading: まぬが・れる【免れる】; まぬが・れる【免】
entries.evidence: Actual Daijisen body at raw HTML offsets approximately65841-66300 identifies an ichidan verb, explicitly recognizes まぬかれる as an alternative and illustrates 戦火を免れる and 責任を免れる. Nikkoku identifies an intransitive ichidan verb and avoiding an unwelcome experience; its auxiliary note contrasts escaping an unpleasant situation with avoiding experiencing one. Full frozen JMdict1584670 retains both unflagged readings and two senses, but labels the verb transitive.
entries.decision: Both pronunciations are valid; no rarity, incorrectness or frequency ranking is inferred from source order or priority flags. Proposed support primaryまぬがれる follows the actual public headword and frozen JMdict first reading, as an explicit teaching choice. Preserve KANJIDIC2 orderまぬか.れる thenまぬが.れる. Select only the latter for practice to avoid duplicate variant questions for one written verb; explain both in separate reading rows and the same word article. Teach unwelcome event/responsibilityを免れる and ichidan forms directly, not a universal transitive/intransitive label. If mentioning classification, disclose the dictionary difference rather than silently correcting one source.
